header.name: record_bytes
header.meaning: Total bytes from record start through final padding, including the 48-byte common header. Derived by encoder; multiple of 8, maximum 1 MiB.

header.name: record_type
header.meaning: Standard schema identifier 1–22. Selects payload layout. It is not a source exchange message ID.

header.name: schema_version
header.meaning: Exactly 1 for every standard record type. A different version is a different wire contract.

header.name: flags
header.meaning: Bit 0 REPLAY; bit 1 SUSPECT. All other bits zero. Flags do not alter byte layout or waive validation.

header.name: publisher_id
header.meaning: Producer-assigned publisher namespace. Nonzero for types 1–8, 10–19 and 21–22. SYSTEM may use 0 with channel 0; FRAME_SUMMARY always does.

header.name: channel_id
header.meaning: Logical producer partition. Zero is valid. Sequence continuity is checked independently per publisher/channel.

header.name: instrument_id
header.meaning: Opaque instrument identity scoped by dataset and publisher. Nonzero for types 1–7, 11–19 and 21–22; zero for GAP, SYSTEM, VENUE_DEF and FRAME_SUMMARY.

header.name: ts_event
header.meaning: Source event time in POSIX nanoseconds; UINT64_MAX means unavailable. BAR requires interval end. It may move backward.

header.name: ts_recv
header.meaning: Producer capture time in POSIX nanoseconds; UINT64_MAX means unavailable. No assumption that it exceeds event time.

header.name: sequence
header.meaning: Normalized output position per container/publisher/channel. Starts at 1, increments by one, never wraps. Not the exchange sequence.

level.name: bid_price
level.meaning: Signed bid price × 10^9. INT64_MIN means this side/level is absent; then its size and count must both be zero.

level.name: ask_price
level.meaning: Signed ask price × 10^9. INT64_MIN means this side/level is absent; then its size and count must both be zero.

level.name: bid_quantity
level.meaning: Bid size × 10^9. Present side requires 1 through UINT64_MAX−1; absent side requires 0.

level.name: ask_quantity
level.meaning: Ask size × 10^9. Present side requires 1 through UINT64_MAX−1; absent side requires 0.

level.name: bid_count
level.meaning: Integral bid order count for this level. Same presence/null rules as bid_order_count.

level.name: ask_count
level.meaning: Integral ask order count for this level. Same presence/null rules as ask_order_count.

level.name: reserved
level.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: price
fields.meaning: Signed currency amount × 10^9. INT64_MIN is null. Negative and zero prices are allowed unless a specific action requires null.

fields.name: quantity
fields.meaning: Nonnegative quantity in definition units × 10^9. UINT64_MAX is null. Action-specific rules distinguish positive size, zero, and null.

fields.name: trade_id
fields.meaning: Nonzero trade identity within instrument/publisher/channel/container. Remains stable through correction and cancellation.

fields.name: original_sequence
fields.meaning: 0 for NEW. CANCEL/CORRECT reference the original NEW sequence in the same scope, not the previous correction.

fields.name: action
fields.meaning: 1 NEW, 2 CANCEL, 3 CORRECT. NEW introduces a trade; CORRECT replaces its values; CANCEL terminates it.

fields.name: aggressor
fields.meaning: 0 unknown, 1 buyer, 2 seller. This is aggressor direction, not resting-order book side. CANCEL requires 0.

fields.name: conditions
fields.meaning: Bit 0 off-book. All other bits zero. CANCEL requires zero.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: bid_price
fields.meaning: Signed bid price × 10^9. INT64_MIN means this side/level is absent; then its size and count must both be zero.

fields.name: ask_price
fields.meaning: Signed ask price × 10^9. INT64_MIN means this side/level is absent; then its size and count must both be zero.

fields.name: bid_quantity
fields.meaning: Bid size × 10^9. Present side requires 1 through UINT64_MAX−1; absent side requires 0.

fields.name: ask_quantity
fields.meaning: Ask size × 10^9. Present side requires 1 through UINT64_MAX−1; absent side requires 0.

fields.name: bid_order_count
fields.meaning: Integral bid order count. Present side: positive or UINT32_MAX (unknown). Absent side: 0.

fields.name: ask_order_count
fields.meaning: Integral ask order count. Present side: positive or UINT32_MAX (unknown). Absent side: 0.

fields.name: quote_flags
fields.meaning: Bit 0 indicative. All other bits zero. This is a complete replacement of both quote sides.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: interval_start_ns
fields.meaning: Inclusive start of a completed bar, POSIX ns, non-null and strictly less than interval_end_ns.

fields.name: interval_end_ns
fields.meaning: Exclusive end of a completed bar, POSIX ns, non-null. Equal to common ts_event.

fields.name: open
fields.meaning: First trade price × 10^9 under the aggregation policy. Null only for empty bars.

fields.name: high
fields.meaning: Maximum trade price × 10^9. Must be at least open and close; null only for empty bars.

fields.name: low
fields.meaning: Minimum trade price × 10^9. Must be at most open and close; null only for empty bars.

fields.name: close
fields.meaning: Last trade price × 10^9 under the aggregation policy. Null only for empty bars.

fields.name: volume
fields.meaning: Traded quantity × 10^9, not currency turnover. Positive/non-null for nonempty bars; zero for empty bars.

fields.name: trade_count
fields.meaning: Positive integral count for nonempty bars; zero for empty bars. UINT32_MAX is not valid for this schema.

fields.name: bar_flags
fields.meaning: Bit 0 empty. Empty bars have four null prices, zero volume, and zero count. All other bits zero.

fields.name: order_id
fields.meaning: Nonzero live-order key in the book scope. 0 only for CLEAR, SNAPSHOT_BEGIN, SNAPSHOT_END. IDs may be reused after deletion.

fields.name: price
fields.meaning: Signed currency amount × 10^9. INT64_MIN is null. Negative and zero prices are allowed unless a specific action requires null.

fields.name: quantity
fields.meaning: Nonnegative quantity in definition units × 10^9. UINT64_MAX is null. Action-specific rules distinguish positive size, zero, and null.

fields.name: priority
fields.meaning: Ascending queue rank/key. UINT64_MAX means unknown. Lower known values have earlier priority at one side/price.

fields.name: action
fields.meaning: 1 ADD, 2 MODIFY, 3 DELETE, 4 CLEAR, 5 SNAPSHOT_BEGIN, 6 SNAPSHOT_END. MODIFY sets absolute remaining size, never a delta.

fields.name: side
fields.meaning: 0 none/control, 1 bid, 2 ask. ADD/MODIFY require bid/ask; DELETE and snapshot/control actions require 0.

fields.name: mbo_flags
fields.meaning: Reserved; zero. No implied execution, partial-fill, or snapshot bits.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: levels
fields.meaning: Number of 48-byte paired bid/ask elements, 0–1024. Encoder derives it from the level array. Unequal depths use absent-side suffixes.

fields.name: book_flags
fields.meaning: Bit 0 depth-limited: deeper prices may exist. All other bits zero. Zero levels is a valid empty observed book.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: price_increment
fields.meaning: Minimum fixed price step × 10^9; positive or INT64_MIN (unknown/variable schedule). Does not change wire scale.

fields.name: quantity_increment
fields.meaning: Quantity step in definition units × 10^9; positive or UINT64_MAX (unknown). Does not change wire scale.

fields.name: contract_multiplier
fields.meaning: Signed fixed-point multiplier × 10^9; positive or INT64_MIN (unknown). No universal cash-value formula is implied.

fields.name: expiration_ns
fields.meaning: Expiration instant in POSIX ns; UINT64_MAX if unavailable/not applicable.

fields.name: underlying_instrument_id
fields.meaning: Same-publisher instrument ID; 0 when absent. Underlying definition need not be included in the container.

fields.name: strike
fields.meaning: Strike price × 10^9; INT64_MIN if unavailable/not applicable. Not enough information to infer option right/style.

fields.name: asset_class
fields.meaning: 0 unspecified, 1 equity, 2 future, 3 option, 4 FX, 5 crypto, 6 index, 7 fixed income.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: symbol_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of symbol, 1–255. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: venue_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of venue, 0–255. Empty is allowed.

fields.name: currency_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of currency code, 1–16.

fields.name: quantity_unit_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of quantity-unit code, 1–32.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: 0 unknown, 1 pre-open, 2 open, 3 halted, 4 closed, 5 auction. Replacement administrative state; does not clear books.

fields.name: reason
fields.meaning: 0 unspecified, 1 scheduled, 2 volatility, 3 regulatory, 4 technical.

fields.name: status_flags
fields.meaning: Reserved; zero.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: first_missing_source_sequence
fields.meaning: Inclusive first missing source-native sequence, or UINT64_MAX when unknown. Both endpoints must be null together.

fields.name: last_missing_source_sequence
fields.meaning: Inclusive last missing source-native sequence, or UINT64_MAX when unknown. If known, first ≤ last.

fields.name: reason
fields.meaning: 1 source packet loss, 2 source reset, 3 producer overflow, 4 unknown discontinuity.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: recovery_id
fields.meaning: Nonzero identifier unique among GAP records in this container. Diagnostic correlation only; not a snapshot ID.

fields.name: code
fields.meaning: 1 heartbeat, 2 info, 3 warning, 4 error. SYSTEM error does not replace END.

fields.name: text_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of text, 0–4096. Heartbeat requires 0.

fields.name: severity
fields.meaning: 0 info for heartbeat/info, 1 for warning, 2 for error. Must agree with code.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: related_recovery_id
fields.meaning: 0, or the recovery ID of an earlier GAP record. Heartbeat requires 0.

fields.name: created_ns
fields.meaning: Date the venue record was created, midnight UTC of the source date in POSIX ns; UINT64_MAX if unavailable.

fields.name: updated_ns
fields.meaning: Date of the last change to the venue record, midnight UTC in POSIX ns; UINT64_MAX if unavailable.

fields.name: expiry_ns
fields.meaning: Date the venue code expires, midnight UTC in POSIX ns; UINT64_MAX when the venue has no expiry.

fields.name: kind
fields.meaning: 1 operating venue, 2 market segment. An operating venue requires mic equal to operating_mic.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: 1 active, 2 updated, 3 expired.

fields.name: mic_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of mic, exactly 4. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: operating_mic_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of operating_mic, exactly 4. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: country_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of country, exactly 2. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: category_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of category, 0 or 4. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: acronym_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of acronym, 0–64. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: city_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of city, 0–128. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: name_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of name, 1–255. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: legal_entity_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of legal_entity, 0–255. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: lei_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of lei, 0 or 20. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: underlying_instrument_id
fields.meaning: Same-publisher instrument ID of the underlying; 0 when it has no ID in this namespace, which requires a non-empty underlying_symbol.

fields.name: expiration_ns
fields.meaning: Expiration instant in POSIX ns. Non-null. Equals the INSTRUMENT_DEF expiration when one exists.

fields.name: strike
fields.meaning: Strike price × 10^9. Non-null. Equals the INSTRUMENT_DEF strike when one exists.

fields.name: contract_multiplier
fields.meaning: Signed fixed-point multiplier × 10^9; positive or INT64_MIN (unknown).

fields.name: right
fields.meaning: 1 call, 2 put.

fields.name: exercise_style
fields.meaning: 0 unknown, 1 American, 2 European. Never inferred from the symbol.

fields.name: settlement
fields.meaning: 0 unknown, 1 physical, 2 cash. Never inferred from the symbol.

fields.name: closing_type
fields.meaning: 0 unknown, 1 normal hours, 2 late hours.

fields.name: option_flags
fields.meaning: Bit 0 pending; bit 1 adjusted (non-standard deliverable). All other bits zero.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: root_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of root, 1–16. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: underlying_symbol_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of underlying_symbol, 0–255. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: osi_symbol_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of osi_symbol, 0 or 21. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: currency_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of currency, 0–16. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: round_lot
fields.meaning: Round-lot size as an integral count of units; UINT32_MAX if unavailable. Not scaled by 10^9.

fields.name: listing_flags
fields.meaning: Bit 0 ETF; bit 1 test issue; bit 2 NextShares. All other bits zero.

fields.name: market_tier
fields.meaning: 0 unspecified, 1 global select, 2 global, 3 capital.

fields.name: financial_flags
fields.meaning: Bit 0 reported; bit 1 deficient; bit 2 delinquent; bit 3 bankrupt. Bits 1–3 require bit 0. Value 1 is normal; 0 means the source reports no financial status.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: symbol_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of symbol, 1–255. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: name_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of name, 0–512. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: listing_mic_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of listing_mic, 0 or 4. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: cqs_symbol_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of cqs_symbol, 0–255. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: alt_symbol_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of alt_symbol, 0–255. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: ts_ref
fields.meaning: Start of the session or date the value refers to, POSIX ns; UINT64_MAX if unavailable.

fields.name: price
fields.meaning: Value × 10^9 for price statistics (types 1–6). Non-null for SET of a price type; INT64_MIN otherwise.

fields.name: quantity
fields.meaning: Value × 10^9 for quantity statistics (types 7–8). Non-null for SET of a quantity type; UINT64_MAX otherwise.

fields.name: stat_type
fields.meaning: 1 open, 2 high, 3 low, 4 close, 5 settlement, 6 VWAP (price types); 7 volume, 8 open interest (quantity types).

fields.name: action
fields.meaning: 1 SET, 2 DELETE. SET replaces the value for (instrument, stat_type, ts_ref); DELETE withdraws it and requires both values null.

fields.name: stat_flags
fields.meaning: Bit 0 preliminary. All other bits zero. DELETE requires zero.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: implied_volatility
fields.meaning: Annualised implied volatility × 10^9 (1.0 = 100%). INT64_MIN is null; otherwise not negative.

fields.name: delta
fields.meaning: Delta × 10^9. INT64_MIN is null; otherwise within −1 to +1.

fields.name: gamma
fields.meaning: Gamma × 10^9, per 1.00 move in the underlying. INT64_MIN is null; otherwise not negative.

fields.name: theta
fields.meaning: Theta × 10^9, currency per calendar day. INT64_MIN is null.

fields.name: vega
fields.meaning: Vega × 10^9, currency per 0.01 change in volatility. INT64_MIN is null.

fields.name: rho
fields.meaning: Rho × 10^9, currency per 0.01 change in rate. INT64_MIN is null.

fields.name: underlying_price
fields.meaning: Underlying price × 10^9 used for the calculation. INT64_MIN is null.

fields.name: theoretical_price
fields.meaning: Model price of the option × 10^9. INT64_MIN is null.

fields.name: price_basis
fields.meaning: 0 unspecified, 1 mid, 2 last, 3 bid, 4 ask, 5 settlement.

fields.name: model
fields.meaning: 0 unspecified, 1 Black-Scholes-Merton, 2 Black-76, 3 binomial, 4 other.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: price
fields.meaning: Level price × 10^9. Non-null for SET and DELETE; INT64_MIN for CLEAR. Levels are keyed by price, not rank.

fields.name: quantity
fields.meaning: New aggregate size at this price × 10^9. SET: 1 through UINT64_MAX−1. DELETE and CLEAR: 0.

fields.name: order_count
fields.meaning: Integral order count at the level; UINT32_MAX if unknown. DELETE and CLEAR require UINT32_MAX.

fields.name: action
fields.meaning: 1 SET, 2 DELETE, 3 CLEAR. SET adds or replaces a level; CLEAR empties one side or the whole book.

fields.name: side
fields.meaning: 1 bid, 2 ask, 0 both. 0 is valid only for CLEAR.

fields.name: delta_flags
fields.meaning: Bit 0 LAST_IN_EVENT: the last delta of one source event. All other bits zero.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: auction_ns
fields.meaning: Scheduled auction time in POSIX ns; UINT64_MAX if unavailable.

fields.name: reference_price
fields.meaning: Reference price × 10^9 for the imbalance. Non-null.

fields.name: near_price
fields.meaning: Indicative price × 10^9 from auction and continuous interest; INT64_MIN if unavailable.

fields.name: far_price
fields.meaning: Indicative price × 10^9 from auction interest only; INT64_MIN if unavailable.

fields.name: paired_quantity
fields.meaning: Quantity × 10^9 matched at the reference price; UINT64_MAX if unavailable.

fields.name: imbalance_quantity
fields.meaning: Unmatched quantity × 10^9. Non-null; zero exactly when imbalance_side is 0.

fields.name: imbalance_side
fields.meaning: 0 none, 1 buy, 2 sell.

fields.name: auction_type
fields.meaning: 0 unspecified, 1 opening, 2 closing, 3 reopening, 4 IPO, 5 intraday.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: valid_from_ns
fields.meaning: Inclusive start of the mapping interval in POSIX ns. Non-null.

fields.name: valid_to_ns
fields.meaning: Exclusive end of the mapping interval in POSIX ns; UINT64_MAX means open-ended. Otherwise greater than valid_from_ns.

fields.name: symbology
fields.meaning: 1 native, 2 OSI, 3 ISIN, 4 FIGI, 5 root, 6 continuous. Root is one-to-many; the others name one instrument at any time.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: symbol_bytes
fields.meaning: UTF-8 byte length of symbol, 1–255. Computed, not character count.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All bytes are zero, including the unusual 3- and 7-byte reserved blocks. Never use as application storage.

fields.name: quantity
fields.meaning: Trade size × 10^9. Positive and non-null.

fields.name: trade_id

fields.name: bid_price

fields.name: interval_ns
fields.meaning: 0 for an event-driven quote; otherwise the sampling interval in ns, with ts_event at the interval end. A duration, not a timestamp.

fields.name: max_instrument_id
